Darda is an AI/ML Engineer who is highly skilled in Generative AI. He has hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG systems. He can develop chatbots with dynamic workflows, contextual awareness, personalization, and multi-turn dialogue handling.

Darda can fine-tune LoRA/QLoRA models for consistent outputs in generative AI applications and design NLP/NLU pipelines for document classification and HR automation. He is proficient in Python, SQL, and cloud AI deployment (AWS, Azure). He is also skilled in backend development, machine learning, data science, and has frontend experience with React.js. Darda is capable of problem-solving, communication, teamwork, leadership, agile project management, and client-facing communication.
